title: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat to parallel, chest tall, knees tracking over toes. Press through the whole foot to stand.
safetyNote: Stop if knee pain rises above 4/10.

title: Box squat to 60 degrees
instructions: Set a box so your knee bends to 60 degrees at the bottom. Sit back to the box, pause, then drive through your heels to stand. Never go deeper than the box.
safetyNote: Knee angle must not exceed 60 degrees. Stop if pain rises.

title: Leg press, 0 to 60 degrees
instructions: Set the safety pin so your knees never bend past 60 degrees. Press through the whole foot. Do not lock out at the top.
safetyNote: Use the safety pin. Stop if knee pain rises above 4/10.

title: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Soft knees, hinge at the hips, bar close to your legs. Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. Do not round your lower back.
safetyNote: Minimal knee bend — safe for knee injuries when done correctly.

title: Hip thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench. Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes hard at the top. Hold one second.

title: Glute bridge
instructions: Heels close to hips, feet flat on the floor. Lift your hips until shoulders, hips, and knees are in a straight line. Hold one second, then lower slowly.

title: Walking lunges
instructions: Take short steps. Keep your front knee directly over your ankle. Do not let the back knee slam the floor.
safetyNote: Avoid if knee pain is present. Requires PT clearance for knee injuries.

title: Lat pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to your upper chest. Lead with your elbows pointing down and back. Do not swing.

title: Seated cable row
instructions: Chest tall. Pull the handle to your lower chest and squeeze your shoulder blades together. Lower with control.

title: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Feet flat on the floor, shoulder blades pinched. Lower the dumbbells for three counts to chest level, then press up without fully locking out.

title: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Back against the pad. Press straight up, elbows slightly in front of your body. Do not arch your lower back.

title: Cable triceps pushdown
instructions: Elbows pinned to your sides. Only the forearms move. Extend fully, then control the weight back.

title: Dumbbell curl
instructions: Keep your elbows still at your sides. Curl the weight up, squeeze at the top, and lower slowly for two counts.

title: Plank
instructions: Elbows under shoulders, ribs pulled down, breathe steadily. Do not let your hips sag or pike.

title: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms straight up, knees at 90 degrees. Lower your opposite arm and leg slowly while keeping your lower back flat on the floor.

title: Step-up (low box)
instructions: Use a low box (20–30 cm). Step up with the full foot, drive through the heel, bring the trailing foot up, then step back down with control.
safetyNote: Use a low box only for knee injuries. Stop if pain rises.

title: Resistance band row
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height. Stand back until there is good tension. Pull the band to your lower chest, elbows back. Pause and return slowly.

title: Brisk walk
instructions: Walk at a pace where you can still hold a conversation but feel your breathing increase. Keep a steady pace.

title: Stationary bike (low resistance)
instructions: Set the resistance low. Pedal smoothly with a slight bend in the knee at the bottom of each stroke. Keep your back upright.
safetyNote: Good cardio option for knee injuries — no impact.

title: Full-body circuit
instructions: Perform each exercise back to back with minimal rest. Choose a weight that lets you complete all reps with good form.
